title: hieracium subintegrum
intro: Hieracium subintegrum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the dandelion-like genus Hieracium. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds, as well as aid in the treatment of various digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium subintegrum include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
